title: Select Mid-360 for the first stationary mapping test
summary: James locked in the existing Livox Mid-360 for the first mapping test: record one stationary scan, save and reopen it independently, and check ground visibility and geometry. D455 integration is deferred for this test. The fixture and numerical acceptance criteria remain to be defined; final payload qualification and research execution are separate.
next: Define the stationary scan fixture and measurable acceptance criteria before acquisition.
